svg.title: Benchmark: stock llama.cpp vs vulkan-moe-streaming
svg.desc: GLM-5.3-Flash 87 GB on an RX 7800 XT 16 GB, Ryzen 5 7600X, 32 GB RAM. Writing the answer: stock 2.34 tokens per second, this project 4.52 (1.9 times). Reading a 1186-token prompt: stock 11.3 tokens per second, this project 81.0 (7.2 times).
svg.text: Same model, same PC, twice the speed.
